title: Federal rulemaking lifecycle
description: Exactly one dataset item per run: the resolved administrative lifecycle of one federal rulemaking (or an ambiguous/not_found/conflict result with candidates). Administrative record only; does not reflect litigation.

resolution.title: Rule lifecycle record
resolution.description: The single record: status, action identifiers, lifecycle stage with stageBasis, comment and effective dates, related official documents with relationBasis, Regulations.gov docket metadata, source statuses and billing flag.
